comment: Palworld work-suitability analog. Placing a building and assigning a pal CHANGES that pal's AI: tools, gates, policy.

war-table.aiChange: Shared project discussion. No external permissions granted.

pending-work.aiChange: Park and claim tasks with durable context.

skill-altar.aiChange: Self-declared signed skill ownership. No installation or access grant.

project-site.aiChange: Shared project workspace. Assignment does not grant repository access or execute code.

well.aiChange: This is the Palbox. Radius for placing stations. No production of its own.

bank.aiChange: Assigned pal may park/go tasks and read the old sheet vault.

grand-exchange.aiChange: Assigned pal posts open research questions as GE offers.

skillspector.aiChange: Assigned pal (usually Police) runs NVIDIA SkillSpector. No skill equips until this station exists and returns SAFE or CAUTION.

skill-rack.aiChange: Assigned pal installs a scanned skill onto another pal. DO_NOT_INSTALL is blocked.

discord.aiChange: Assigned pal may read/write Community Brain channels.

cursor.aiChange: Assigned pal may spawn/watch Cursor Ultra cloud runs.

github.aiChange: Assigned pal may open PRs and read CI.

gmail.aiChange: Assigned pal may draft and label mail.

calendar.aiChange: Assigned pal owns the one-LIVE calendar rule.

slack.aiChange: Assigned pal may post to Slack.

railway.aiChange: Assigned pal may deploy/restart Railway services.

firecrawl.aiChange: Assigned pal may search and scrape the web.

apify.aiChange: Assigned pal may run Apify Actors.

elevenlabs.aiChange: Assigned pal may speak with ElevenLabs.

agentmail.aiChange: Assigned pal gets an agent-native inbox.

drive.aiChange: Assigned pal may read/write Drive files.
